direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh, overflow hidden at 1366x768; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; compact horizontal rail only with equal-width non-wrapping targets, aria-current and arrow-key movement; main uses independent reserved zones for rendered scene, callouts, stations and jobs with zero overlap; enlarge rendered scene to at least 70% of main; condense side content inside its reserved zone to maintain viewport fit, never introduce vertical rail
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald green and brushed silver only: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 headings, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) secondary; emerald/neon #A8F04A sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, cross marker and plain OFFLINE text, never red; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px; header tabs span most of header width with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; tabular numerals
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; single 240ms route trace on real state change then static; no loops or pulses; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while silver pattern, cross marker and OFFLINE text carry meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left at native aspect and Lock recovery room right; opening story retains second required logo placement; compact horizontal rail built from single steps array with equal-width targets, aria-current and arrow-key roving; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene in its reserved zone; side zone keeps connection readiness checks for provider identity separate from investigation evidence task under distinct headings, status and controls, never conflated; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form, do not infer missing functionality from pre-selection screenshots; pending task proposal deliberately untracked until human approval, blocked prior tasks and approved recovery plan coexist while replacements await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG enlarged to fill at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with cross marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text

fixes.change: Enlarge the factory scene to at least 70% of main; current boxed grid leaves opening-story metrics and option cards competing inside the scene zone.
Keep the second official logo placement in the opening story at native aspect and raise scene callout labels to 16px where they sit below that size.
Add bidirectional highlighting between Certificate 120 / Receiving 80 tracks and the three source-evidence cards in the reserved callout zone.
Separate provider identity readiness under its own heading from the distinct Investigate source evidence task, each with its own status and control.
Enlarge the scene to at least 70% of main and refit the side zone without overlap; narration in the connection panel is dense at 1366x768.
Raise small route-note text to 16px body or 12px micro-label minimum and add a visible emerald focus ring to the route selector.
Make each Select this path control open the typed consent form on selection and show that state change in the Human decision zone.
Enlarge the scene toward 70% and link hovering or focusing a side path to its matching station and job nodes in the SVG.
Increase secondary finish and incremental labels that fall below clear legibility while keeping one primary action in the action bar.
Preserve PROPOSED and UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL on all three tasks until approval; keep progress bars from implying tracked progress before consent.
Refit station and job cards as one cinematic SVG scene filling at least 70% of main, with t1-t3 in their reserved jobs zone.
Add arrow-key movement and aria-current clarity between the 1-2-3 task selectors and the detailed proposal card.
Use silver cross-hatching plus cross marker and plain OFFLINE text for the applied stopped state; keep the current dashed treatment only as clearly labelled preview.
Enlarge the preview scene to at least 70% of main so the 24h to 0h change and feasible route read before the side panel.
Raise preview micro-text to at least 12px and pair the machine selector with a stronger emerald focus ring.
Strengthen CELL-MILL-2 stopped treatment with dense silver cross-hatching, a clear cross marker and plain OFFLINE text, with no route drawn through it.
Keep provider identity readiness separate from the evidence investigation task in the side zone; do not merge their status sentences.
Enlarge the SVG to at least 70% of main and announce the 3 to 2 feasible paths change through aria-live polite.
Keep the constrained Split path visibly unavailable with pattern and text, and ensure only the two feasible paths can open the typed consent form.
Link side-zone path focus to the corresponding scene nodes and retain PRIOR ACCEPTANCE INVALIDATED status in the action bar centre.
Raise dim finish and incremental placeholders to readable silver contrast without adding another primary action.
Keep 3 BLOCKED prior tasks visually and semantically separate from the 3 PROPOSED replacements awaiting approval, as currently shown.
Show CELL-MILL-2 with silver cross-hatching, cross marker and OFFLINE text in the station zone rather than plain text alone.
Refit the left scene as a state-driven SVG at at least 70% of main while preserving the strong blocked-versus-proposed side hierarchy.
Enlarge the 01-02-03 proof sequence into the dominant scene zone at at least 70% of main; the side evidence panel currently carries most meaning.
Keep Verify, Seal and Retain as sequential locked states with 16px instructions and a clear focus ring on the enabled Verify ledger control.
Condense passphrase narration to one instruction and one status sentence while retaining the 16 to 160 character requirement.
Align the board header state with the displayed columns: To do 3, In progress 0, Blocked 0, Done 0 should not be paired with a conflicting step title or invalidating action bar from another stage.
Refit columns into independent reserved zones at 1366x768 with full card titles visible; the single tall card wastes the Blocked and Done zones.
Add arrow-key movement between task selectors 1-3, a 2px emerald focus ring, and 16px card body text for owner, due and dependency details.
